name: Grade 8 IT Practice: May Week 12 - Presentation
description: Practice words for Grade 8 first-trimester work.

words.definition: An explanation of the portfolio, design choices, and evidence.
words.example: The presentation showed the portfolio and explained the design choices.
Using large icons was a design choice for quick scanning.

words.definition: An explanation of which portfolio design choices improved after feedback.
words.example: The reflection explained what improved after feedback.

words.definition: The viewers who need the portfolio explanation to be clear.
words.example: The student adjusted the explanation for a Grade 8 audience.

words.definition: A revision that makes the portfolio clearer, more accurate, or easier to use.
words.example: The improvement made the source credits easier to find.

words.definition: A collection of work that shows learning.
words.example: The portfolio showed the final website, poster, and research notes.
